title: D2P Mesh Profile
description: Versioned vocabulary of panel meshing parameters (design decision ADR-021 §5 rule 3: every meshing output has a versioned sampling profile). A profile is pinned before any comparison run and never adjusted afterwards to fit an implementation; a frozen profile is immutable and a changed value is a new version. A provisional profile holds proposed values only. Files are stored as vocabularies/mesh-profiles/<local>-<version>.json for profileId d2p:<local>.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

profileId.description: Qualified name of the profile; with version it identifies the profile.

version.description: Version of the profile, independent of the standard version.

status.description: provisional: proposed values, not to be used for comparing implementations; frozen: adopted and immutable.

maxPlanarDeviationMm.description: Largest permitted planar deviation of a mesh boundary from the pattern contour (bounds maxApproximationErrorMm, D2P-SEM-125).

toleranceProfile.description: Tolerance profile results of this profile are compared with.

notes.description: Free-text notes on provenance and status of the values.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest). Pins of this profile digest the whole file instead.

boundarySampling.title: Boundary sampling
boundarySampling.description: How pattern edges are sampled into the mesh boundary.

maxChordDeviationMm.description: Largest permitted distance between a boundary chord and the edge curve.

minSamplesPerEdge.description: Minimum number of boundary vertices per edge, including both end points.
